stem:
This chart details information about the economies of two U.S. regions in the nineteenth century.

Economic Differences between North and South in the 1800s

North
• produced fabrics and other manufactured goods
• large wage-laborer workforce

South
• produced cotton and other cash crops
• large enslaved workforce

Which statement describes a cause of the economic differences in this chart?

options.label: A
options.text: The Southern region had better conditions for plantation farming than the North had.

options.label: B
options.text: The Northern region had less access to railroads for transporting goods than the South had.

options.label: C
options.text: There were higher rents for workers in the South than there were in the North.

options.label: D
options.text: There were fewer geographic barriers isolating the North than there were in the South.

visual_elements: chart with two columns labeled North and South showing economic differences
